## Purpose

Add the sheet every later lesson works on, beside the stockroom sheet the learner
already has.

## Learning objectives

- Create `forecast.csv` with the four columns of the design.

## Theory

The forecast lives beside the counts it is made from, so each estimate can be traced
back to the numbers behind it.

## Completion conditions

`forecast.csv` exists with a header row naming the four columns.
